passages.locator: Section: Pasteurization, an invention to save wine
passages.quote: On April 11, 1865, Pasteur filed a patient "for a process for the preservation of wine": "Wine does not spoil if the microbes are killed beforehand. A simple, practical method is to heat the wine to a temperature between 60 and 100°C."

file.method: Passages of about 500 characters either side of each cited quotation, cut from the fetched page text.
